args.spec_yaml:
app: demo
scientific_artifacts: [field]
entity_types:
  - name: deck
    store: file
    role: input
    id_scheme: input deck path relative to run dir
    description: The input deck that configures the simulation run.
  - name: field
    store: file
    role: output
    id_scheme: step=N
    description: The simulated field snapshot written at a step, the artifact.
activities:
  - name: simulate
    where: sim.c:run
    used: [deck]
    generated: [field]
